plugins.name: ultrapowers-dev
plugins.description: Development skills for Claude Code: language best practices, framework patterns, architecture, testing, and AI agent patterns

skills.name: Agent Loop
skills.description: Use when a task requires autonomous multi-step reasoning with tool calls, where the number of steps is not known in advance.
skills.description_zh: 用于需自主多步推理及工具调用、且预先不知道步骤数量的任务。

skills.name: Angular Patterns
skills.description: Use when building frontend applications with Angular — covers components, services, dependency injection, signals, standalone components, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Angular前端开发，覆盖组件、服务、依赖注入、signals、独立组件及测试。

skills.name: API Design
skills.description: Use when designing REST APIs, choosing URL structures, handling errors in responses, implementing pagination, or planning API versioning.
skills.description_zh: 用于REST API设计，确定URL结构、错误响应、分页及版本管理。

skills.name: Architecture
skills.description: Use when making system-level architecture decisions, choosing between monolith and microservices, selecting architectural patterns, or designing system boundaries.
skills.description_zh: 用于系统架构决策，选择单体或微服务、架构模式及系统边界。

skills.name: Auth & Security
skills.description: Use when implementing authentication, authorization, or security controls — covering identity, access, and defense against common vulnerabilities.
skills.description_zh: 用于实现认证、授权及安全控制，覆盖身份、访问管理和常见漏洞防护。

skills.name: Background Jobs
skills.description: Use when designing task queues, async workers, or event-driven processing that runs outside the request-response cycle.
skills.description_zh: 用于设计请求响应周期之外的任务队列、异步工作进程或事件驱动处理。

skills.name: browser-automation
skills.description: Use when an AI agent needs to interact with websites — navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, or automating any browser task
skills.description_zh: 帮助AI智能体操作网站，导航页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截屏、提取数据或自动化浏览器任务。

skills.name: C/C++ Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing C/C++ code. Covers memory management, RAII, smart pointers, const correctness, CMake, sanitizers, and common undefined behavior pitfalls.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写或审查C/C++代码，覆盖内存管理、RAII、智能指针、const正确性、CMake、sanitizers及常见未定义行为。

skills.name: Caching
skills.description: Use when adding caching to a system, choosing cache strategies, designing invalidation logic, or diagnosing cache-related bugs.
skills.description_zh: 用于系统缓存接入、策略选择、失效逻辑设计及缓存相关缺陷诊断。

skills.name: CI/CD
skills.description: Use when designing continuous integration and deployment pipelines — covering stages, deployment strategies, rollback, and pipeline performance.
skills.description_zh: 用于设计持续集成与部署流水线，覆盖阶段、部署策略、回滚及流水线性能。

skills.name: C# Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing C# code. Covers C#-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查C#代码，覆盖语言惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；SOLID、TDD和整洁架构等通用原则另见相关分类技能。

skills.name: DAG Workflows
skills.description: Use when a multi-step process has dependencies between steps, some of which can run in parallel, with shared state and conditional routing.
skills.description_zh: 用于步骤间有依赖、部分步骤可并行且涉及共享状态或条件路由的多步流程。

skills.name: Dart Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Dart code. Covers Dart-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写或审查Dart代码，覆盖语言惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；SOLID、TDD和整洁架构等通用原则另见相关分类技能。

skills.name: Database Design
skills.description: Use when designing schemas, writing migrations, optimizing queries, choosing indexes, or deciding between normalization and denormalization.
skills.description_zh: 用于数据库模式设计、迁移编写、查询优化和索引选择，并权衡规范化与反规范化。

skills.name: Design Patterns
skills.description: Use when making structural design decisions, applying SOLID principles, choosing between inheritance and composition, or deciding when to introduce an abstraction.
skills.description_zh: 用于结构设计决策，应用SOLID原则，选择继承或组合，并判断何时引入抽象。

skills.name: Django Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Python web applications with Django — covers models, views, ORM, migrations, admin, Django REST Framework, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Django的Python Web开发，覆盖模型、视图、ORM、迁移、管理后台、Django REST Framework及测试。

skills.name: e2e-testing
skills.description: Use when writing end-to-end UI tests, setting up Playwright or Cypress, or debugging flaky tests — covers test structure, selectors, waiting strategies, and CI integration
headings: Page Object Model (optional but recommended for large suites)
skills.description_zh: 用于编写端到端UI测试、配置Playwright或Cypress及排查不稳定测试，覆盖结构、选择器、等待策略和CI集成。

skills.name: Error Handling
skills.description: Use when designing error handling strategies, choosing between exceptions and result types, validating inputs, or building resilient systems in any language.
skills.description_zh: 用于设计错误处理策略，选择异常或结果类型、验证输入及构建可靠系统，适用于各种语言。

skills.name: Express Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Node.js web servers with Express — covers middleware chains, routing, error handling, security, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Express的Node.js Web服务器开发，覆盖中间件链、路由、错误处理、安全和测试。

skills.name: FastAPI Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Python APIs with FastAPI — covers async endpoints, dependency injection, Pydantic models, middleware, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于FastAPI的Python API开发，覆盖异步端点、依赖注入、Pydantic模型、中间件及测试。

skills.name: Flask Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Python web applications with Flask — covers blueprints, extensions, application factory, context management, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Flask的Python Web开发，覆盖蓝图、扩展、应用工厂、上下文管理和测试。

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Use when building web components, pages, or applications — guides creation of distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic AI aesthetics
skills.description_zh: 指导构建Web组件、页面或应用，创建有鲜明特色且达到生产要求的前端界面，避免通用AI模板式视觉。

skills.name: Go Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Go code. Covers Go-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Go代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: Java Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Java code. Covers Java-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Java代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: JavaScript Best Practices
skills.description: Modern JavaScript patterns for non-TypeScript projects covering ES2024+ idioms, tooling, and common pitfalls
skills.description_zh: 为非TypeScript项目提供现代JavaScript模式，涵盖ES2024及以后惯用法、工具和常见陷阱。

skills.name: Kotlin Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Kotlin code. Covers Kotlin-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Kotlin代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: Laravel Patterns
skills.description: Use when building PHP web applications with Laravel — covers Eloquent ORM, middleware, queues, Blade templates, Livewire, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Laravel的PHP Web开发，涵盖Eloquent ORM、中间件、队列、Blade模板、Livewire及测试。

skills.name: Multi-Agent Debate
skills.description: Use when a decision benefits from adversarial perspectives, where a single LLM call might be biased or miss edge cases.
skills.description_zh: 用于需要对立观点辅助的决策，减少单次LLM调用的偏差及遗漏边界情况。

skills.name: Multi-Agent Handoffs
skills.description: Use when a conversation spans multiple domains and should be routed between specialized agents based on context.
skills.description_zh: 用于跨多个领域的对话，根据上下文在专门智能体之间路由和交接。

skills.name: NestJS Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Node.js backends with NestJS — covers modules, controllers, providers, pipes, guards, interceptors, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于NestJS的Node.js后端开发，涵盖模块、控制器、providers、pipes、guards、拦截器及测试。

skills.name: Next.js Patterns
skills.description: Use when building or reviewing Next.js applications. Covers App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, data fetching, caching, ISR, and middleware patterns.
skills.description_zh: 用于构建审查Next.js应用，涵盖App Router、Server Components、Server Actions、数据获取、缓存、ISR及中间件。

skills.name: Observability
skills.description: Use when instrumenting systems with structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing to achieve production visibility.
skills.description_zh: 通过结构化日志、指标和分布式追踪为系统增加生产可观测性。

skills.name: Orchestrator-Workers
skills.description: Use when a complex task can be decomposed into subtasks that benefit from specialized prompts or models.
skills.description_zh: 用于可拆成子任务且适合专门提示或模型处理的复杂任务编排。

skills.name: Parallelization
skills.description: Use when the same input needs multiple independent analyses, or the same task should be run multiple times for voting or redundancy.
headings: Sectioning: different analysis on same input
skills.description_zh: 用于对同一输入做多项独立分析，或重复同一任务进行投票和冗余验证。

skills.name: PHP Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing PHP code. Covers PHP-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查PHP代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: Plugin Development
skills.description: Use when creating, structuring, validating, or publishing Claude Code plugins and self-hosted marketplaces — covers plugin.json manifests, skill authoring, marketplace setup, versioning, and multi-platform distribution.
skills.description_zh: 用于创建、组织、验证和发布Claude Code插件及自托管市场，涵盖plugin.json、技能编写、市场配置、版本及多平台分发。

skills.name: Python Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Python code. Covers Pythonic idioms, modern tooling (uv, ruff, pyright), project layout, and pytest conventions.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Python代码，涵盖Python惯用法、uv/ruff/pyright工具、项目布局及pytest约定。

skills.name: RAG & AI Retrieval
skills.description: Use when building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines — covering chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking for grounded LLM responses.
skills.description_zh: 用于构建检索增强生成流水线，涵盖分块、嵌入向量、向量搜索及重排，为LLM回答提供检索依据。

skills.name: Rails Patterns
skills.description: Use when building Ruby on Rails applications — covers convention over configuration, ActiveRecord, concerns, jobs, and testing.
skills.description_zh: 用于Ruby on Rails开发，涵盖约定优于配置、ActiveRecord、concerns、后台任务及测试。

skills.name: Ratatui Patterns
skills.description: Use when building terminal user interfaces with ratatui — covers app architecture (Elm/TEA), async event loops with crossterm EventStream, PTY rendering with tui-term, terminal pane management, color theming, snapshot testing, and co-running with HTTP servers like axum.
skills.description_zh: 用于ratatui终端界面开发，涵盖Elm/TEA架构、crossterm EventStream异步循环、tui-term的PTY渲染、终端窗格、配色、快照测试及与axum等HTTP服务共运行。

skills.name: react-best-practices
skills.description: Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code — 62 performance optimization rules across 8 categories, prioritized by impact
skills.description_zh: 用于编写、审查或重构React/Next.js代码，按影响优先排序原文所列8类62条性能优化规则。

skills.name: React Patterns
skills.description: Canonical patterns for React applications covering component design, hooks, state management, and data fetching
skills.description_zh: 提供React应用的组件设计、hooks、状态管理及数据获取常用模式。

skills.name: Resilience
skills.description: Use when building systems that must survive transient failures, network partitions, and downstream service degradation.
skills.description_zh: 用于构建能应对临时故障、网络分区及下游服务退化的系统。

skills.name: Ruby Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Ruby code. Covers Ruby-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Ruby代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: Rust Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Rust code. Covers ownership idioms, cargo tooling, error handling with Result/Option, module layout, and testing conventions.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Rust代码，涵盖所有权惯用法、cargo、Result/Option错误处理、模块布局及测试约定。

skills.name: Spring Boot Patterns
skills.description: Use when building or reviewing Spring Boot applications. Covers auto-configuration, layered architecture, Bean lifecycle, profiles, actuator, and testing with MockMvc.
skills.description_zh: 用于构建审查Spring Boot应用，涵盖自动配置、分层架构、Bean生命周期、profiles、actuator及MockMvc测试。

skills.name: SQL Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing SQL queries. Covers query optimization, indexing strategies, JOINs, CTEs, window functions, and EXPLAIN analysis across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查SQL查询，涵盖PostgreSQL、MySQL及SQLite的查询优化、索引、JOIN、CTE、窗口函数及EXPLAIN分析。

skills.name: Supabase Patterns
skills.description: Use when building with Supabase. Covers row-level security, realtime subscriptions, edge functions, auth, and PostgreSQL best practices within the Supabase platform.
skills.description_zh: 用于Supabase开发，涵盖平台内行级安全、实时订阅、边缘函数、认证及PostgreSQL实践。

skills.name: Swift Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Swift code. Covers Swift-specific idioms, tooling, project layout, and testing conventions. For universal principles (SOLID, TDD, clean architecture) see the relevant category skills.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查Swift代码，涵盖惯用法、工具、项目布局及测试约定；通用SOLID、TDD和整洁架构原则另见相关技能。

skills.name: Tailwind Patterns
skills.description: Use when building UIs with Tailwind CSS. Covers utility-first approach, design tokens, responsive patterns, custom themes, plugin system, and component extraction.
skills.description_zh: 用于Tailwind CSS界面开发，涵盖实用类优先方法、设计令牌、响应式模式、自定义主题、插件及组件提取。

skills.name: Testing & TDD
skills.description: Use when writing tests, practicing test-driven development, designing test suites, or deciding what and how to test in any language or framework.
headings: Red Flags: Your Tests Are Lying
skills.description_zh: 用于编写测试、实践TDD、设计测试套件及决定测试对象和方式，适用于各种语言或框架。

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Use when an LLM needs to interact with external systems, APIs, or data sources through structured function calls.
skills.description_zh: 用于LLM通过结构化函数调用与外部系统、API或数据源交互。

skills.name: Type Safety
skills.description: Use when leveraging type systems to prevent bugs at compile time — covering generics, contracts, narrowing, and using types as documentation.
skills.description_zh: 利用类型系统在编译阶段防止缺陷，涵盖泛型、契约、类型收窄及用类型表达文档。

skills.name: TypeScript Best Practices
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript code. Covers type system patterns, modern tooling (biome, vitest), tsconfig settings, and testing conventions.
skills.description_zh: 用于编写审查TypeScript代码，涵盖类型系统模式、biome/vitest工具、tsconfig设置及测试约定。

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.description: Use when asked to review UI code, check accessibility, audit design, review UX, or check a site against best practices
skills.description_zh: 用于审查UI代码、检查无障碍、设计审计、UX评审及网站最佳实践核查。
